import unittest

from solution import rank_artifact_submissions


class RankArtifactSubmissionsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ranking_normalization_stability_and_non_mutation(self):
        expected_files = ["report.pdf", "data.csv"]
        submissions = [
            {"team": "  Beta ", "members": [" Bea ", "Bob"], "files": ["data.csv", "report.pdf"], "score": 9},
            {"team": "alpha", "members": [" Ann "], "files": ["report.pdf", "data.csv"], "score": 9.0},
            {"team": "ALPHA", "members": ["Amy"], "files": ["data.csv", "report.pdf"], "score": 9.0},
            {"team": "Gamma", "members": ["Gus"], "files": ["report.pdf", "data.csv"], "score": 7.5},
        ]
        before = [{key: (value[:] if isinstance(value, list) else value) for key, value in item.items()} for item in submissions]
        result = rank_artifact_submissions(submissions, expected_files)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"team": "alpha", "members": ["Ann"], "score": 9.0},
            {"team": "ALPHA", "members": ["Amy"], "score": 9.0},
            {"team": "Beta", "members": ["Bea", "Bob"], "score": 9},
            {"team": "Gamma", "members": ["Gus"], "score": 7.5},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(submissions, before)
        self.assertEqual(expected_files, ["report.pdf", "data.csv"])
        for returned in result:
            self.assertTrue(all(returned is not original for original in submissions))
            self.assertTrue(all(returned["members"] is not original["members"] for original in submissions))

    def test_empty_submissions_and_empty_expected_files(self):
        self.assertEqual(rank_artifact_submissions([], []), [])
        submission = {"team": "Solo", "members": ["One"], "files": [], "score": 0}
        self.assertEqual(rank_artifact_submissions([submission], []), [
            {"team": "Solo", "members": ["One"], "score": 0}
        ])

    def test_wrong_outer_record_and_scalar_types(self):
        calls = [
            ((), []),
            ([], ()),
            ([[]], []),
            ([{"team": 1, "members": ["A"], "files": [], "score": 1}], []),
            ([{"team": "T", "members": "A", "files": [], "score": 1}], []),
            ([{"team": "T", "members": [1], "files": [], "score": 1}], []),
            ([{"team": "T", "members": ["A"], "files": (), "score": 1}], []),
            ([{"team": "T", "members": ["A"], "files": [1], "score": 1}], ["x"]),
            ([{"team": "T", "members": ["A"], "files": [], "score": True}], []),
            ([], [1]),
        ]
        for submissions, files in calls:
            with self.subTest(submissions=submissions, files=files):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    rank_artifact_submissions(submissions, files)

    def test_incorrect_keys_blanks_duplicates_and_nonfinite_scores(self):
        base = {"team": "T", "members": ["A"], "files": ["x"], "score": 1}
        invalid = [
            {"team": "T", "members": ["A"], "files": ["x"]},
            dict(base, extra=2),
            dict(base, team="  "),
            dict(base, members=[]),
            dict(base, members=[" "]),
            dict(base, members=[" A ", "A"]),
            dict(base, files=["x", "x"]),
            dict(base, score=float("inf")),
            dict(base, score=float("nan")),
        ]
        for submission in invalid:
            with self.subTest(submission=submission):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    rank_artifact_submissions([submission], ["x"])
        for files in ([""], ["x", "x"]):
            with self.subTest(files=files):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    rank_artifact_submissions([], files)

    def test_file_set_must_match_exactly_regardless_of_order(self):
        good = {"team": "T", "members": ["A"], "files": ["b", "a"], "score": 1}
        self.assertEqual(rank_artifact_submissions([good], ["a", "b"])[0]["team"], "T")
        for files in (["a"], ["a", "c"], ["a", "b", "c"]):
            bad = dict(good, files=files)
            with self.subTest(files=files):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    rank_artifact_submissions([bad], ["a", "b"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
